figurative_meaning_en: To show oneself present or make an appearance
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় সবাই এসেছে, তুমি কেন মুখ দেখাওনি?
পার্টিতে তার মুখ দেখানোর দরকার ছিল না।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone came to the meeting; why didn't you show your face?
He didn't need to put in an appearance at the party.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali social norms around visibility and participation in communal events.
